notes.title: Drop convenience update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Drop frequency has been reduced
[*] Ananas Companion is now checking for drops every minute instead of 5
[*] Supporter edition got its first supporter perks
[/list]

notes.title: Minor maintenance update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Redeem codes library has been enriched by more codes
[*] The Lazy button turns on after (auto) prestiging for better time efficiency when idling
[*] Additional precautions implemented to ensure stability
[/list]

Click multiplier has been renamed to “Collect power” as this name better fits upgrade’s function. Keep in mind that final amount of ingame money earned is also affected by prestige.

As some of you have already found out, there’s redeemable code “2024” which  rewards player with 1k points to Automatic collection.
Not only that upgrades got buffed recently, all the future redeem codes have multiplying/percentual power, too! Feel free to try - here’s a code that will multiple your Collect power by random number between 2 and 10! Just redeem a code “ananas”! ːsteamhappyː

Just a friendly reminder - redeem codes are meant for one use per progress so use them wisely; only if player chooses to reset the progress and does so, redeem codes can be redeemed again.

If you would find a minute or two to write Ananas a review, it will help getting us closer to release [b]trading cards[/b] to level up Steam profiles ✌🏻 Thanks a lot! And you know what? Here you go, use the “review” code to 10x your Collect power! 😁🎉

notes.content:

notes.title: Launch of Drops is finally here!
notes.content:
Howdy, partners!

Thank you all for your patience. Finally I can announce the drops being brought to [i]Ananas - Pineapple Idle game[/i]!

The reason why I didn't come with drops earlier is incompatible engine. That is why I created [b]Ananas Companion[/b] app that behaves as [b]a launcher to Ananas - Pineapple Idle game[/b]. Soon, the [i]Ananas - Pineapple Idle game[/i] and [i]Ananas Companion[/i] will be merged. Instead of working on merge apps first and bringing drops then, I wanted to give you drops first and merge apps later.

Keeping [i]Ananas Companion[/i] launched is enough to get drops. At this moment, 1 drop is released every 30 minutes. There's 1% chance of getting Lotto item.

In upcoming "Community creators competitions", players can upload their Ananas skins on our Discord server and everyone can vote for which skin is going to win a financial reward. #1st placed skins will be then used in-game and are going to have their own droppable items. [b]Community creators competitions starts Q1 2025.[/b]



[b]Live streams with developer buying Lotto items for totally random values from marketplace will start soon. It of course depends on players activity on marketplace.[/b]


[u]Latest start of Lotto events will come in January 2025[/u],
but I would love to launch them right on Christmas 2024 (Xmas stream with first Lotto event), let's see how the community's going to be active :-) Random means random, $1 item will have the same chance of picking as $2000 item. When I buy the item, I post it back on marketplace for its preset price.


[b]Ananas Companion[/b]
- Behaves as Ananas - Pineapple Idle game launcher
- Manages getting drops
- Shows remaining time before checking for another drop

[b]Ananas - Pineapple Idle Game[/b]
- Works as it worked before ːsteamhappyː



Updates in queue:
- Option to merge lower quality items to get higher quality items
- Merge of Ananas - Pineapple and Ananas Companion into one (remaking game in different engine)
- In-game music player
- Upgrade of visual and technical functions (f.e. UI, Delta times, making the game more responsive...)
- Appliable skins based on inventory
- More minigames


I'm open to any suggestions, ideas, you name it. Have a question or anything on your mind? Say, ask or feel free to join our recently created [url=https://discord.gg/cygQjspTm4]Discord server[/url].
